title: Marathi Inscription
brief_description: Crude, sculptured, plaque of basalt containing Marathi inscription.
detailed_description: Crude, sculptured, plaque of basalt containing Marathi inscription on three sides horizontal lines on upper and lower portion and vertical lines on the right side. Sun is depicted on top right. In the center a woman is depicted as tending a donkey; she holds a knot (rope?) in her left hand.The inscriptionis partly obliterated in the upper portion. Left and lower portions are broken.
